params.name: afterId
params.description: When paginating this is used to provide the starting point for the page to fetch (retrieved from the previous response body)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per query

params.name: ownerType
params.description: The type of the owner (currently only CUSTOMER is supported)

params.name: ownerId
params.description: The ID of the owner (for CUSTOMER type, this is the customerId)

params.name: assetTypeId
params.description: Asset type identifier. This will return Trusted Destinations with a matching assetTypeId, as well as Trusted Destinations with a matching networkId if network level is true.
